subject: reasoning
question: If DEAF is coded as 123 and CAN is coded as 45, then how would BEAK be coded?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8aaeade6fc2b4c81e2929de9e09e0fa86552e0d1a62d52624200ce9c0a071002.png] 

**Multiplication of alphabet positional value + 3 **

 DEAF is coded as 123

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2cd971e386dadede7c7cdc6e2ecd47591e6a6a8f571a84c76b04817c9168f909.png] 

⇒ (4 × 5 × 1 × 6) + 3 = 120 + 3 = 123

and 

CAN is coded as 45

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4dabbb12f3042cd38f5dfbe6b8778c90a25dad5d95beff6b6ef7b2ee6322d62.png] 

⇒ (3 × 1 × 14) + 3 = 42 + 3 = 45

Similarly,

**BEAK will be coded as :**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45e17c3296f69ae12815c61792c5f6e3b56604c7c213d27ae012ce0b90466e67.png] **

**⇒ (2 × 5 × 1 × 11) + 3 = 110 + 3 = 113**

Hence, the correct answer is **"113".**
